name: ETFR: per-eye density map
description: In the default stereo mode (both eyes in one double-wide layer) builds the game's fragment density map pattern once per eye instead of once across both, so each eye gets its own full-density region. Use with "ETFR: per-eye gaze offset". True multiview maps are left alone.

hooks.name: create_fdm
hooks.prototype: void* original_create_fdm(void* out, int rt_width, int rt_height, unsigned layers)
hooks.evidence: renderingpipelines.dll 0x16C70 (reverse_study 2026-10-16): the only function referencing "foveated_fdm_texture_%d_%d_%d" and logging "Creating fragment density map with size: %ux%ux%u (RT: %ux%ux%u)"; size = (RT + 31) >> 5, cached per size; calls 0x5D60 (map builder) and, for layers > 1, copies layer 0 to layer 1. Entry: mov [rsp+20h],r9d; mov [rsp+10h],edx.

hooks.name: fdm_pattern
hooks.prototype: xrg_i64 original_fdm_pattern(int level, char square, unsigned width, unsigned height, void* out)
hooks.evidence: renderingpipelines.dll 0x5450 (reverse_study 2026-10-16), called by the builder 0x5D60 (fove_square && !fove_square_use_legacy, or radial): level presets inner/outer/min (0.3/0.6/80 .. 0.2/0.4/32) overridden by fove_radial_inner/outer/min; side = min(width, height) centred in the map; pushes two bytes (density, density) per texel into an MSVC std::vector<unsigned char> (grow through 0x6410) that 0x5D60 reserved for 2 * width * height and emptied. Entry: mov rax,rsp; mov [rax+20h],r9d.
